home.title: Recruiting Intelligence Platform
home.subtitle: Find, qualify, and contact the best refrigeration technicians and HVAC-R specialists in Quebec — from job boards to DEP training centers, all the way to fit ranking.

sources.title: Sources under control
sources.body: Jobillico, Indeed, Jobboom, LinkedIn and the 7 DEP Refrigeration centers — every source is governed by an explicit policy before any automated collection.

vetting.title: Quebec compliance
vetting.body: DEP, CCQ apprentice/journeyman, ASP 30h, SF-1, SF-2, halocarbons, driver's license — qualification signals are detected and flagged for the recruiter.

scoring.title: Advisory scoring
scoring.body: Every candidate is ranked on a weighted, explainable rubric. The AI recommends, the recruiter decides — always.

home.advisory_note: The fit score is advisory. The recruiter verifies certifications before any hiring decision.

DEP.title: DEP Refrigeration 5386
DEP.description: The primary pool — apprentices, graduating students, and recent graduates ready to deploy. Ideal window: 90 to 180 days before cohort end, reactivation at 30 days.

DEC.title: DEC 221.C0 — Building Mechanics
DEC.description: Complementary pool — commissioning, controls, estimating, maintenance, junior project management.

AEC.title: Targeted AECs
AEC.description: Requalification and upskilling — technicians already in the workforce.

sources.title: Source directory
sources.subtitle: Every sourcing channel with its access policy. The switch is the legal gate: no automated collection runs without explicit authorization.
sources.policy_note: Strict rule: enabling scraping on a source is a human decision, made after reviewing its terms of service. Indeed and LinkedIn prohibit it — use manual import or assisted capture. Every change is written to the audit log.
